launch_B_v11 admission. Lane identity is by cwd/ancestry (cwd inside moqls7-maximum or a review/moqls7-* desk, or a descendant) over a validated census: two ps identity snapshots bracket a ps args snapshot and an lsof cwd listing. A process is consistent only if it is present in both identity snapshots with equal ppid/pgid/uid/lstart/comm and has args of the same lstart. Helpers are bounded and fail-closed, readers need explicit EOF, and lsof records must be complete. An unresolved own-uid identity, or any process (any uid, zombies included) whose argv the B/C411 veto cannot resolve, is retried and then refused. Conditions: <= 2 busy lane natives; lane RSS + 2 GiB <= 8 GiB; fixed RSS cap 2,797,076,480 B (Main) with ancestry headroom min(3.5 GiB, 8 GiB - ancestry reservations - 128 MiB) >= that cap; the slot-2 condition (B/C411 r7 reaped and end-recorded, matched on resolved full argv); no other attempt process of this desk; every M7-lane native outside this desk's ancestry in the route-A attempt-5 group (single-admitter invariant); free >= 12,201,048,576 B at the first and the final census, at least 60 s apart. Main's 07:32 PDT long-job stability amendment is evaluated on the parent monitor before AND after the final census: last free >= 13.5e9 B; max 300 s peak-to-later drop <= max(300 MB, (free_last - 13.5e9)/12); >= 25 tz-aware strictly increasing samples spanning >= 290 s; age 0..30 s. Immediately before spawn the launcher rechecks free bytes, the deadline (no launch after 17:30 PDT, and launch + 10,380 s <= 17:57 PDT), its signals, quarantine records and the monitor sample age (0..30 s). The gate receipt is written right after the spawn inside run_owned()'s ownership scope.
D1-D12 and D14 of deviations-v1.json (1ec0309c...4afb) apply unchanged.
